entities.name: Joshua Reed Giddings
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joshua Reed Giddings was an American attorney, politician and abolitionist. He represented Northeast Ohio in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1838 to 1859. He was at first a member of the Whig Party and was later a Republican, helping found the party.
